beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 vitality item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Melee Lifesteal. Your melee hit slows the target by 48% for 2.5 seconds and heals you for 35% of the melee damage plus 120. The heal is 40% as strong against non-heroes. The cooldown is 4 seconds. It also adds 16% melee damage and 125 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: Melee becomes a way to heal and to hold enemies in place.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a close fighter who uses melee attacks during a fight.

name: Lightning Scroll
text: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay. This effect can only trigger once per target per ultimate. Mystic Slow effects

effects.text: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay. This effect can only trigger once per target per ultimate. Mystic Slow effects

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item that costs 6,400 souls and is built from Mystic Slow. Damage from your ultimate stuns the target and adds 150 spirit damage after 3 seconds. This can happen once per target per ultimate. It also adds 50 health and a little sprint speed, and slows targets that take spirit damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes your ultimate stronger without a button press.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero whose ultimate hits enemies. It adds nothing if your ultimate does not damage anyone.

name: Long Range
text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

effects.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls. You deal 40% more Weapon Damage to a target more than 15 metres away. It also lengthens your gun's effective range by 8% and adds a little sprint speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: A big damage bonus for staying back and shooting from safety. It upgrades into Sharpshooter.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero whose weapon is accurate at range. A close-range fighter should pick Close Quarters instead.

name: Lucky Shot
text: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.

effects.text: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 weapon item that costs 6,400 souls. Each bullet has a 25% chance to be empowered and deal 100% bonus weapon damage on hit; this bonus cannot be a critical hit. It also adds 30% to your magazine size.
beginner.whyItMatters: On average it adds a quarter more damage on top of every bullet, but it comes in unpredictable spikes. The more bullets you fire, the more steady it becomes.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who fires a lot of bullets, since the chance works on every one. A hero with a slow weapon gets less from it.

name: Magic Carpet
text: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

effects.text: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item with a button that costs 6,400 souls. Press it to summon a carpet in 1.3 seconds and fly for up to 12 seconds, with extra fly speed and immunity to slows. Doing any action dismisses it, and you cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned. It also adds 125 health, 14 Spirit Power and 15% ability duration.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a way to cross the map quickly or to escape a bad fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to flee or to rotate to another lane. It will not help in the middle of a fight, because summoning it leaves you unable to cast.

name: Majestic Leap
text: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster. Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

effects.text: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster. Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 vitality item with a button that costs 3,200 souls. Press it to launch high into the air and gain a 200 point Barrier for 8 seconds. Press it again while airborne to drop faster. You cannot use it for 5 seconds after an enemy hero hits you. The cooldown is 45 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: A fast way to cross a gap, escape a fight or reach a high spot, with a shield to protect the landing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to escape or to approach from above, before you are attacked.

name: Melee Charge
text: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

effects.text: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls. Your next heavy melee attack against an enemy deals 25% more damage, and the cooldown is 5 seconds. It also adds 10% melee damage, 6% Bullet Resist and a longer heavy melee distance. It builds into Crushing Fists.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes heavy melee a worthwhile part of fights instead of a last resort.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it if you enjoy mixing melee with shooting or plan to build toward Crushing Fists. Skip it if you always stay at range.

name: Melee Lifesteal
text: Your next Melee attack heals you. This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

effects.text: Your next Melee attack heals you. This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 vitality item that costs 800 souls. Your next melee attack heals you for 100, 30% as much against non-heroes. The cooldown is 8 seconds. It also adds 12% melee damage. It builds into Lifestrike.
beginner.whyItMatters: A cheap heal for a close fighter, and a stepping stone to Lifestrike.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it early if you plan to use melee attacks in your lane fights.

name: Mercurial Magnum
text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

effects.text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item that costs 6,400 souls and is built from Quicksilver Reload. You attach it to one ability. Over 14 seconds it charges up 60 bonus spirit damage and 22% fire rate, and using the ability reloads your gun. Until your next reload your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power. It also adds 20% magazine size and 7 Spirit Power.
beginner.whyItMatters: It joins your gun and your abilities together, so using a spell gives you a full magazine and stronger shots.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who casts one main ability and also shoots a lot.

name: Metal Skin
text: Become immune to bullets.

effects.text: Become immune to bullets.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 vitality item with a button that costs 3,200 souls. Press it to become immune to bullets for 5 seconds. While active your move speed and dash distance drop. The cooldown is 24 seconds. It also adds 12% Bullet Resist.
beginner.whyItMatters: Bullets do nothing to you for a few seconds. It does not protect against abilities.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it when a lot of bullets are aimed at you, and keep it for those moments. It does not save you from spells.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 weapon item that costs 800 souls. You deal 25% more weapon damage to non-player units such as troopers and jungle monsters, and you have 25% Bullet Resist against them. It also adds 1 health regeneration out of combat. It builds into Cultist Sacrifice.
beginner.whyItMatters: Clearing camps and troopers faster means more souls sooner, and taking less bullet damage from them keeps you healthy while you farm. Against enemy heroes it gives no bonus.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A good early buy for a hero who farms a lot, especially if you plan to upgrade it into Cultist Sacrifice.

name: Mystic Burst
text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

effects.text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 spirit item that costs 800 souls. It charges up for 14 seconds, and your next ability that deals more than 80 damage deals 40 extra spirit damage. It builds into Tankbuster.
beginner.whyItMatters: Extra damage on a regular rhythm, which is a good deal for such a cheap item.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A cheap early buy for a hero whose abilities hit hard in the lane.

name: Mystic Conduit
text: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies. Dealing significant Damage to an enemy Hero within 5s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.

effects.text: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies. Dealing significant Damage to an enemy Hero within 5s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 5 spirit legendary of the Street Brawl mode, which you can only take when the draft offers it. It gives you and your allies an aura with 40% more ability range and 40% less cooldown (half as strong on allies). Once you put 300 damage into an enemy hero inside 5 seconds, a 700 heal goes out to you and every ally standing within 35 metres. The cooldown is 25 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It powers up a whole team and heals them when they land damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only used in Street Brawl. Take it when your team fights close together.

name: Mystic Expansion
text: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

effects.text: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 spirit item that costs 800 souls. You attach it to one of your abilities, which then has 20% more range and effect size. It builds into Ballistic Enchantment and Greater Expansion.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes one ability reach farther and hit more targets. It is also the first step for two other items.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Attach it to an ability that you often miss, or when you plan to build the items that use it.

name: Mystic Regeneration
text: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

effects.text: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 spirit item that costs 800 souls. Dealing spirit damage to enemy heroes grants 4 health per second for 7 seconds, and the effect stacks across different heroes. It also adds 50 health. It builds into Radiant Regeneration.
beginner.whyItMatters: Your abilities heal you a little, which helps you win trades in the lane.
beginner.whenToUseIt: An early buy for an ability hero who trades often with the enemy in lane.

name: Mystic Reverb
text: Imbue an ability with Lifesteal and to apply slow on a hit target and deal an additional percentage of the damage dealt to enemies around the target after a short delay.

effects.text: Imbue an ability with Lifesteal and to apply slow on a hit target and deal an additional percentage of the damage dealt to enemies around the target after a short delay.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item that costs 6,400 souls. You attach it to one ability. That ability gains 22% spirit lifesteal and slows the target by 32%, and deals 50% of the damage again to enemies within 16 metres of the target after 3 seconds. The cooldown is 6.25 seconds. It also adds 8% spirit lifesteal.
beginner.whyItMatters: One ability becomes a slow, a healer and a delayed area attack all in one.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Attach it to an ability that hits for a lot of damage and lands often.

name: Mystic Shot
text: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.

effects.text: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls. Your next bullet deals 40 bonus spirit damage, and the cooldown is 8 seconds. It also adds 7 Spirit Power.
beginner.whyItMatters: It adds a regular chunk of spirit damage on top of your normal bullets, and the 7 Spirit Power it gives also strengthens your abilities.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it for a hero who mixes bullets and abilities. The bonus goes off on your next bullet by itself and comes back every 8 seconds, so you get the most from it when that bullet hits an enemy hero rather than a trooper.

name: Mystic Slow
text: When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.

effects.text: When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 spirit item that costs 1,600 souls. Targets who take spirit damage from you are slowed by 24% for 2 seconds. It also adds 50 health and a little sprint speed. It builds into Lightning Scroll.
beginner.whyItMatters: Every ability that hits also slows, which makes your next hit easier to land.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for an ability hero with quick, repeated damage. The first step toward Lightning Scroll.

name: Mystic Vulnerability
text: When an enemy takes spirit damage, they have their spirit resist reduced.

effects.text: When an enemy takes spirit damage, they have their spirit resist reduced.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 spirit item that costs 1,600 souls. When an enemy takes spirit damage, their resistance to spirit damage drops by 8% for 7 seconds. It also adds 8% resistance to spirit damage for you. It builds into Escalating Exposure.
beginner.whyItMatters: Everyone on your team who deals spirit damage benefits from the debuff, not only you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when your team has more than one ability hero.

name: Mystical Piano
text: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

effects.text: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

beginner.whatItIs: A Street Brawl legendary, tier 5, with a button; it exists only in that mode and never appears in the shop. Press it on an area and, after 1.7 seconds, enemies in the 12m radius are stunned and lose their stamina, then are dazed for 2 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a group stun with a 1.7 second delay, so enemies who react in time can step out of it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only in Street Brawl. Use it when enemies are bunched up and cannot easily leave, such as when they are fighting something else.

name: Nullification Burst
text: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

effects.text: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 5 vitality legendary for Street Brawl only, gained through the draft. Press it for a burst up to 20 metres that deals 250 damage, removes positive effects from enemies, and stops them using Stamina or receiving healing for 7 seconds. The cooldown is 18 seconds. It also adds 300 health and 40% Debuff Resist.
beginner.whyItMatters: It strips the enemy of boosts and heals just as you fight them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only used in Street Brawl. Press it as the fight begins to catch enemies off guard.

name: Omnicharge Signet
text: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

effects.text: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 5 spirit legendary drafted in Street Brawl; regular matches never offer it. You attach it to any non-ultimate ability. If the ability already has charges it gets 4 more, and otherwise it gets 2. It also adds 70% faster time between charges and 30% less cooldown for abilities with charges.
beginner.whyItMatters: One ability can be used many times in a row, so it dominates a fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only used in Street Brawl. Attach it to your best ability.

name: Opening Rounds
text: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

effects.text: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls and is built from High-Velocity Rounds. While your target is still above 50% health, your shots hit 25% harder. It also adds 60% bullet speed, 8% Weapon Damage and 7 Spirit Power.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes the start of every fight hit harder. Once your target drops below half health the bonus no longer applies.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when you want to win the first exchange of each fight. It is weaker for a hero who needs to finish low health targets.

name: Phantom Strike
text: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

effects.text: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 vitality item with a button that costs 6,400 souls. Press it to teleport to an enemy target within 25 metres, pull them to the ground, deal 75 damage, slow them by 40% and stop them from using weapons for 3 seconds. The cooldown is 35 seconds. It also adds 15% Weapon Damage and 8 Spirit Power.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets you reach a target who thinks they are out of range, and it also keeps their gun silent for a moment.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to jump onto a squishy target. It leaves you in the middle of the enemy team, so have a plan for after.

name: Plated Armor
text: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

effects.text: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 vitality item that costs 6,400 souls. Incoming bullets have a 30% chance to be deflected so they deal no weapon damage, or a 50% chance to have their on-hit effects prevented. It also adds 130 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: A chance to ignore some shots altogether. Because it relies on luck, it is smoother when many bullets are coming in.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a tank who is shot at by many bullets. It does nothing against abilities.

name: Point Blank
text: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

effects.text: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 weapon item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Close Quarters. Within 15 metres of your target you deal 50% more Weapon Damage, and your bullets slow the target by 20% for 2 seconds. It also adds 75 health and 30% melee resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: A big upgrade for close-range fighting. The slow stops enemies from backing away from you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who wants to be in the enemy's face. Do not buy it for a hero who fights from far away.

name: Prism Blast
text: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

effects.text: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 5 spirit legendary with a button, available only through the Street Brawl draft. Press it to become untargetable and invincible for 6 seconds while lasers spin around you, dealing 270 damage per second to nearby enemies. The cooldown is 40 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is both a defence and a large area attack at the same time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only used in Street Brawl. Use it when enemies are all around you.

name: Quicksilver Reload
text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.

effects.text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 spirit item that costs 1,600 souls. You attach it to one ability. Over 18 seconds it charges 44 bonus spirit damage and 10% fire rate, and using the ability reloads your gun fully. It builds into Mercurial Magnum.
beginner.whyItMatters: A spell that also reloads your gun helps you keep shooting in a fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Attach it to an ability you cast often, for a hero who also uses a gun.

name: Radiant Regeneration
text: Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability. Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

effects.text: Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.
Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 spirit item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Mystic Regeneration. Casting an ability heals you for 65 and gives 1.75 metres per second of move speed for 3 seconds (cooldown 6 seconds). Dealing spirit damage to enemy heroes also gives 4 health per second, stacking across heroes. It adds 90 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: Casting spells keeps you healthy and moving.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for an ability hero who casts often in fights.

mods.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 spirit item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Extra Charge. It adds 2 charges to abilities that use charges, 30% faster time between charges, 14% less cooldown for them and 14 Spirit Power for them.
beginner.whyItMatters: It multiplies the use of any ability that already works with charges.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it only for a hero with a charge-based ability.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 weapon item that costs 800 souls. It adds 9% fire rate.
beginner.whyItMatters: More shots each second is more damage each second. It is a component for Burst Fire and Swift Striker.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A cheap early buy for any hero who relies on the gun, and the first step if you plan to build Burst Fire or Swift Striker.

name: Reactive Barrier
text: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

effects.text: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 vitality item built from Grit. You gain a 325 point Barrier whenever you are stunned, chained, immobilised, put to sleep or silenced. The barrier lasts 10 seconds and the cooldown is 55 seconds. It also adds 1 extra regeneration out of combat. It builds into Indomitable.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gives you a shield when you are locked down, which is when you are most exposed.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it against teams that stun and slow a lot. Remember that the cooldown is long, so the shield works once per 55 seconds.

name: Rebuttal
text: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

effects.text: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 vitality item that costs 800 souls. When you successfully block a melee attack from an enemy hero, you heal for 100% of the damage blocked, return that damage to the attacker and gain 30% bonus damage for 6 seconds. It also adds 18% melee resistance and 75 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: It rewards a well-timed block with healing and a counterattack.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it if you enjoy blocking melee attacks and your lane opponent likes to hit you in melee.

name: Recharging Rush
text: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

effects.text: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls. If you deal 200 weapon damage within 3.5 seconds, each of your abilities that uses charges gains one back. The cooldown is 25 seconds. It also adds 20% magazine size and 10% Weapon Damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Landing your shots gives you more uses of your abilities, so shooting and casting feed each other.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it for a hero whose abilities hold several charges. It does nothing for an ability that has no charges.

name: Refresher
text: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

effects.text: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item with a button that costs 6,400 souls. Press it to reset the cooldowns of all your abilities and restore all your charges. The cooldown is 300 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: Everything you just used comes back, including your ultimate, which can decide a fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it in a major team fight right after you have spent your abilities, especially your ultimate. With 300 seconds between uses, save it for fights that decide something.

name: Rescue Beam
text: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

effects.text: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 vitality item with a button, built from Healing Rite. Channel it for 2.5 seconds to heal yourself and an ally within 35 metres by a share of Max Health (20% in the data; the sources do not say whose maximum it uses), and once during the channel you can pull the ally to you. You can cast it on yourself. The cooldown is 60 seconds. It also adds 6% ability range and 0.75 m/s sprint speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: It saves a teammate from danger by healing them and pulling them away from the fight.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a supporting role. Use it on an ally who is cut off or about to die.

name: Restorative Locket
text: When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack. Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.

effects.text: When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack. Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 vitality item with a button that costs 1,600 souls. Each time an enemy uses an ability near you, you store a stack, up to 25. Press it to spend all stacks, healing 16 per stack and regaining up to 3 Stamina. The cooldown is 20 seconds. It also adds 8% resistance to spirit damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: Enemy abilities become your healing, which is more useful against heroes who cast a lot of spells.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it against a team that uses lots of abilities. Use it after the stacks build up in a fight.

name: Restorative Shot
text: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

effects.text: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 weapon item that costs 800 souls. Your next bullet heals you for 50 if it hits a hero or 20 if it hits a trooper or orb. The cooldown is 6 seconds. It also adds 6% Weapon Damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: A bit of healing while you are laning, which lets you stay in the lane longer before needing to retreat.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A good early buy in the laning phase for any hero who shoots often. It matters less in later fights.

name: Return Fire
text: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

effects.text: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 vitality item with a button that costs 1,600 souls. Press it for 6.5 seconds, during which you automatically fire back at anyone who damages you, with 65% of the bullet damage and 25% of the spirit damage you took. The cooldown is 23 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: Anyone who attacks you takes damage back, even when you are busy doing something else.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it when you are being hit and cannot fire back, for example when you are running or casting.

name: Ricochet
text: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

effects.text: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 weapon item that costs 6,400 souls. Your bullets bounce to up to 2 enemies within 13 metres of your target, each dealing 65% of the original damage and copying your bullet effects. It also adds 18% fire rate.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each shot hits several targets when enemies stand close, so it is a strong choice against groups and troopers.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when fights happen in clumps, such as around an objective. In a one on one duel the bounce adds nothing and only the 18% fire rate still helps.

name: Runed Gauntlets
text: Pierces through parry. Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

effects.text: Pierces through parry. Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 5 weapon legendary of the Street Brawl mode, taken from the draft rather than bought. It always gives 150% heavy melee distance, 30% melee damage and 50% melee resistance. Your heavy melee can also pierce through a parry, and that part has a 10 second cooldown. Separately, each heavy melee that lands cuts your current cooldowns by 16% (at least 4 seconds); no cooldown is listed for that part.
beginner.whyItMatters: It turns melee into the centre of your play, and the cooldown reduction keeps your abilities coming back.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only used in Street Brawl. Take it if you plan to play as a melee fighter.

name: Rusted Barrel
text: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

effects.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 spirit item that costs 800 souls. Press it on an enemy within 32m to lower their fire rate by 32% and their Bullet Resist by 8% for 5 seconds. It also gives +60 health and +0.5 m/s sprint speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: It weakens an enemy shooter and makes them easier to shoot, for a short 16 second cooldown. It builds into Disarming Hex.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on the enemy who is dealing the most damage to you or your team. Hold it for a fight, not for the first target you see.

name: Scourge
text: Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

effects.text: Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item with a button that costs 6,400 souls. Press it on a friendly target within 35 metres, or yourself, to give them 40% resistance to spirit damage, 20% Debuff Resist and an aura that deals 2.3% of enemies' maximum health per second within 10 metres, for 10 seconds. It also reduces debuffs on them. The cooldown is 35 seconds. It adds 100 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: It protects an ally and turns them into a damage source. Percentage damage works well against big targets.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a frontline hero who is about to step into the enemy team.

name: Seraphim Wings
text: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

effects.text: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

beginner.whatItIs: A Street Brawl legendary, tier 5, that only that mode's draft can give you. It is always on: it gives unlimited air jumps and air dashes, much better air control, and while you are in the air you deal 40% more damage and take 40% less.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets you fight from the air, where you are both stronger and tougher. It also gives +120% stamina recovery.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only in Street Brawl. Take it when it is offered and you want to stay airborne and shoot down at enemies.

name: Shadow Strike
text: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

effects.text: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 5 vitality legendary exclusive to Street Brawl, where it shows up in the draft. Using Stamina makes you invisible for 3 seconds with no detection range. A melee attack while invisible takes away 40% of their Bullet Resist and of their resistance to spirit damage for 6 seconds, and hurts them for 125 damage per second. It also adds 3 Stamina and 350 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: You can vanish on demand and strike a target who does not see you coming.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only used in Street Brawl. Take it for a hero who likes to ambush.

name: Shadow Weave
text: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed. Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.

effects.text: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed. Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 weapon item with a button, built from Sprint Boots. Press it to turn invisible for up to 13 seconds with a large boost to sprint speed. If you attack or use an ability you end the stealth and start a 5 second ambush with 25% fire rate, 25 Spirit Power and 25% melee damage. Taking damage reveals you for a moment.
beginner.whyItMatters: You choose when and where a fight begins, and you get a strong bonus for striking from hiding.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to sneak behind the enemy, to catch a lone target or to move around the map unseen. It is a poor fit for open head-on fights.

name: Sharpshooter
text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

effects.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 weapon item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Long Range and High-Velocity Rounds. You deal 60% more Weapon Damage to targets more than 15 metres away. It also adds 20% weapon range, 25% zoom, 60% bullet speed and 10% Weapon Damage, but lowers move speed a little.
beginner.whyItMatters: The damage bonus is large, but only while you keep your target at a distance, so it pays off most when teammates hold the front line.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero with a long range weapon who stays behind teammates. If enemies keep rushing you, the damage bonus will not trigger.

name: Shrink Ray
text: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

effects.text: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

beginner.whatItIs: A Street Brawl legendary, tier 5, that you can only get from that mode's draft. Press it to shrink a target's model by 50% for 60 seconds, which also gives +5 m/s move speed and +20% fire rate. You can use it on yourself.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a mode item, so you will not see it in regular matches. In Street Brawl it lets a small target use tunnels and run faster for a minute, on a 30 second cooldown.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only in Street Brawl. Use it on yourself or on a teammate when you need speed and the ability to fit through tunnels.

name: Silence Wave
text: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

effects.text: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

beginner.whatItIs: A spirit item with a button. Press it and an expanding wave flies out, silences the enemies it touches for a short time and deals damage that starts at 75 and grows with your Spirit Power. It also gives +50 health all the time.
beginner.whyItMatters: A silence is a way to stop enemies at the moment they act. It does not interrupt an ability that is already being channeled, so the wave works before an enemy starts casting, not after.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when the enemy team leans on abilities and you can spare a slot for an item you have to press. It has a 42 second cooldown, so hold it for the moment an enemy is about to cast rather than spending it on the first target you see.

name: Silencer
text: Your bullets reduce the target's outgoing spirit damage. Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

effects.text: Your bullets reduce the target's outgoing spirit damage. Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 weapon item that costs 6,400 souls. Your bullets lower the target's spirit damage by 25% for 6 seconds and slowly build toward a silence, which stops them using abilities. After a silence ends they cannot be silenced by this item for 10 seconds. It also adds 12% resistance to spirit damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a way to stop an enemy caster using abilities just by shooting them, which helps against heroes who rely on spells.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when the enemy team has a dangerous caster that you can reach with bullets.

name: Siphon Bullets
text: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

effects.text: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 vitality item that costs 6,400 souls. Your bullets take a slice of the target's maximum health (2.5% per steal, at most once every 1.2 seconds), and they get it back when the 17 second effect ends. It also adds 15% Weapon Damage and 10% Bullet Resist.
beginner.whyItMatters: It reduces the health of a target over a long fight, which makes them easier to kill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a gun hero who fights the same enemy for a long time.

name: Slowing Bullets
text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

effects.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls. Each bullet builds up a movement slow on the target (24% when full) for 3.5 seconds, and reduces their dash distance. It builds into Weighted Shots.
beginner.whyItMatters: A slowed enemy is easier to hit and cannot escape, which helps you chase kills and stops enemies from chasing you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when you want to catch runners or when you play with a team that has strong follow-up damage.

name: Slowing Hex
text: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities. Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage.

effects.text: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities. Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 spirit item with a button that costs 1,600 souls. Press it on an enemy within 25 metres to slow them by 16%, cut their dash distance by 26%, make them heavier and block their movement items and abilities for 3.5 seconds. The cooldown is 29 seconds. It builds into Vortex Web.
beginner.whyItMatters: It stops an enemy from running away with dashes and movement tricks.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on a target who tries to escape. It does not stop them from using Stamina.

name: Spellbreaker
text: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

effects.text: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 vitality item that costs 6,400 souls and is built from Debuff Reducer. The next time you take a big hit of spirit damage (over 175) it is reduced by 65%. The cooldown is 9 seconds. It also adds 18% resistance to spirit damage, 25% Debuff Resist and 90 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: It reduces the next spirit hit over 175 that you take, whichever one arrives first, not the biggest one. A 200 damage hit just before a large burst can use it up, and then it needs 9 seconds to come back.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it against a team with large single spells. It does less against many small hits.

name: Spellslinger
text: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

effects.text: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 weapon item that costs 6,400 souls. Each time you use an ability or item in combat you gain a stack, up to 6, that gives you 11% more fire rate and cuts your reload time by 10% for 18 seconds. It also adds 5% Ability Cooldown Reduction.
beginner.whyItMatters: It connects spells and gun. Each spell cast makes your gun better, and each stack refreshes the timer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero that casts often and also shoots. Cast your abilities to build stacks before you commit to shooting.

name: Spirit Burn
text: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing. The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

effects.text: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing. The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item that costs 6,400 souls. After you deal at least 500 spirit damage to an enemy within 5 seconds, it makes an explosion and a burn that last 8 seconds. It also adds 6% Ability Range.
beginner.whyItMatters: The burn does 24 damage per second and cuts the enemy's incoming healing by 70%. Each enemy can only be burned once per cooldown.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it against enemies who heal a lot, or when you want extra damage from a spirit build.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 vitality item that costs 1,600 souls. 13% of the spirit damage you deal comes back to you as health. It also adds 90 health and 6 Spirit Power. It builds into Infuser, Leech and Spiritual Overflow.
beginner.whyItMatters: Your abilities heal you, which keeps ability heroes alive in long fights.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero whose damage comes from abilities. If you mostly shoot, Bullet Lifesteal is the match.

name: Spirit Rend
text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them. Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.

effects.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.
Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 weapon item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Spirit Shredder. Your bullets lower the target's resistance to spirit damage by 8% and give you and your allies 10% spirit lifesteal against them. Headshots lower it further, up to 4 times. It also adds 75 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: Everyone on your team deals more ability damage to the target and heals while doing so. It makes a good team item.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when your team uses a lot of abilities and you can keep shooting the enemy's main target.

name: Spirit Resilience
text: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

effects.text: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 vitality item that costs 3,200 souls. It gives 30% resistance to spirit damage, and another 15% when you are below 50% health. It also adds 3 extra regeneration out of combat.
beginner.whyItMatters: Ability damage hurts less, especially when you are in trouble.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when the enemy team does most of its damage with abilities. If they shoot, pick Bullet Resilience.

name: Spirit Sap
text: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

effects.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 spirit item with a button that costs 1,600 souls. Press it on an enemy within 40 metres to lower their resistance to spirit damage by 9% and their Spirit Power by 30 for 12 seconds. The cooldown is 18 seconds. It also adds 50 health. It builds into Focus Lens.
beginner.whyItMatters: The target takes more ability damage and deals less of it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it on an enemy caster before a fight starts.

name: Spirit Shielding
text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

effects.text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 vitality item built from Grit. If you take 225 spirit damage from enemy heroes within 3.5 seconds you gain a 300 point Barrier for 8 seconds. The cooldown is 45 seconds. It also adds 18% resistance to spirit damage and 2.5 extra regeneration out of combat.
beginner.whyItMatters: It soaks up a burst of ability damage automatically.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it against a team with strong spirit bursts.

name: Spirit Shredder
text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

effects.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls. Your bullets lower the target's resistance to spirit damage by 8% for 8 seconds and give you and your allies 10% spirit lifesteal against that target. It builds into Spirit Rend.
beginner.whyItMatters: The whole team's ability damage rises while the debuff is on. Spirit lifesteal means damage dealt with abilities also heals.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A strong support pick when your team uses lots of abilities, and the first step toward Spirit Rend.

name: Spirit Snatch
text: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power. Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

effects.text: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power. Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 spirit item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Spirit Strike. A melee attack on a hero deals 50 extra spirit damage and steals 12% of their resistance to spirit damage and 25 of their Spirit Power for 10 seconds. The cooldown is 6 seconds, and light melee attacks have 30% less effect. It also adds 7% melee damage and 75 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: Melee becomes a way to take power from the enemy and give it to yourself.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who mixes melee attacks into fights.

name: Spirit Strike
text: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist. Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

effects.text: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist. Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 spirit item that costs 800 souls. A melee attack on a hero deals 40 spirit damage and lowers their resistance to spirit damage by 6% for 6 seconds. The cooldown is 8 seconds, and it is twice as long when a light melee attack triggers it. It builds into Spirit Snatch.
beginner.whyItMatters: A cheap boost for heroes who use melee attacks.
beginner.whenToUseIt: An early buy for a melee fighter who wants to build toward Spirit Snatch.

name: Spiritual Overflow
text: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting heroes.

effects.text: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting heroes.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 weapon item that costs 6,400 souls and is built from Spirit Lifesteal. Shooting heroes charges it up, and when full you gain 25% fire rate, 30 Spirit Power and 10% spirit lifesteal for 15 seconds. It also adds 13% ability duration, 13% spirit lifesteal, 90 health and 6 Spirit Power.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes landing shots on heroes power up your abilities and your healing. It rewards a hero who mixes gun and spell damage.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when you can keep your gun on enemy heroes and your abilities also do damage.

name: Split Shot
text: Make your weapon fire multishot. Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus. Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

effects.text: Make your weapon fire multishot. Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus. Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item with a button that costs 1,600 souls. Press it and your weapon fires 5 bullets for 5 seconds. Hitting more than one hero with one attack gives a stacking 8% Weapon Damage bonus, up to 5 stacks. The cooldown is 27 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is useful in fights against groups, because your shots spread out over many targets.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it when the enemy team is standing close together. Against a single target the stacking bonus never triggers.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 1 vitality item that costs 800 souls. It adds 2 metres per second of sprint speed and 2 extra regeneration out of combat. Later it can become Trophy Collector, Enduring Speed or Shadow Weave.
beginner.whyItMatters: Moving faster helps in every part of the game, from farming to escaping. It is also a component for three other items.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A cheap early buy when you want to get around the map faster, and the first step toward the three items that use it.

name: Stalker
text: Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed. Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time, have reduced bullet resist, and are revealed through walls.

effects.text: Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed. Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time, have reduced bullet resist, and are revealed through walls.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls. Damaging an enemy from within 8 metres opens a wound for 5 seconds: the target takes 17 spirit damage per second, loses 6% Bullet Resist and is revealed through walls, and you gain 1.5 metres per second of move speed. The cooldown is 6 seconds. It also adds 50 health and quieter footsteps.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets you track targets and keep pressure on them as they run.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who hunts one enemy at a time and fights up close.

name: Stamina Mastery
text: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

effects.text: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 vitality item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Extra Stamina. It adds 2 Stamina, 18% Stamina recovery and 23% air jump and dash distance. It also lets you air jump or air dash one more time before landing.
beginner.whyItMatters: More movement in the air means harder targets to hit and faster travel.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a mobile hero who keeps moving during fights.

name: Superior Cooldown
text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

effects.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 spirit item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Compress Cooldown. It reduces the cooldown of your abilities by 20% and adds 4 extra regeneration out of combat. It builds into Transcendent Cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: Using abilities more often is more damage and more control.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who casts abilities all the time. Continue to Transcendent Cooldown if you want more.

name: Superior Duration
text: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

effects.text: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 spirit item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Duration Extender. It lengthens your abilities and items by 28% and adds 8% Bullet Resist.
beginner.whyItMatters: Slows, shields and buffs last longer, so each cast gives you more time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero whose abilities are traps, auras or buffs.

name: Suppressor
text: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

effects.text: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 spirit item that costs 1,600 souls. When you deal spirit damage to enemies you also cut their fire rate by 28% for 4.5 seconds. It also adds 6 Spirit Power and 8% Bullet Resist.
beginner.whyItMatters: Your abilities weaken enemy guns, and the Bullet Resist helps you.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it against a team full of gun heroes when your abilities hit often.

name: Surge of Power
text: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

effects.text: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 spirit item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Extra Spirit. You attach it to one of your abilities, which gets 28 permanent Spirit Power. Using that ability also gives you 1.75 metres per second of move speed and 20% fire rate for 8 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: It makes one ability stronger for good and turns each cast into a short burst of speed in which you can keep shooting. The bonus has a 14 second cooldown.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Attach it to an ability you cast often. Buy it when you want to move and shoot while casting.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls and is built from Rapid Rounds. It adds 20% fire rate and a little sprint speed. It has no button and no special effect.
beginner.whyItMatters: More fire rate means more damage every second, and the item has no condition to meet.
beginner.whenToUseIt: A simple step up from Rapid Rounds for any hero who relies on the gun.

name: Tankbuster
text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

effects.text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 spirit item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Mystic Burst. It charges for 14 seconds, and then your next ability that deals more than 165 damage deals 40 extra damage plus 7.5% of the target's current health, ignoring their resistance to spirit damage. It also adds 50 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: A big hit against a target with a lot of health.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when the enemy team has tanky heroes.

name: Tesla Bullets
text: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

effects.text: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 weapon item that costs 3,200 souls. Each bullet has a 15% chance to shock the target for 33 damage, and the shock jumps to up to 4 other enemies within 8 metres. It builds into Capacitor.
beginner.whyItMatters: It adds extra damage that also spreads to nearby enemies and troopers, which helps when fighting in groups and clearing waves.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when you fire a lot of bullets in crowded fights or want to clear troopers fast.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls and is built from Extended Magazine. It adds 100% to your magazine size and 14% to your weapon damage, with nothing to press.
beginner.whyItMatters: A magazine twice as big means long stretches of shooting without a reload, and the damage bonus works on every bullet. Owning Extended Magazine first takes its price off the total.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it as the next step after Extended Magazine on a hero who keeps the trigger down. It is less useful for a hero who mostly fires a few shots between abilities.

name: Torment Pulse
text: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

effects.text: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 spirit item that costs 3,200 souls. Every 1.4 seconds it deals 25 spirit damage to the two closest enemies within 9 metres. It also adds 100 health and 18% melee resistance.
beginner.whyItMatters: A steady stream of damage with no button to press. It hits troopers too, so it helps with farming.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who fights up close and wants extra damage without effort.

name: Toxic Bullets
text: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

effects.text: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 weapon item that costs 3,200 souls. Your bullets build up a bleed that removes a percentage of the target's maximum health over time (1.9% per second) for 4 seconds, and lowers the healing they receive by 35%.
beginner.whyItMatters: Percentage damage is best against enemies with lots of health, and the healing reduction counters healers and lifesteal.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when you face tanky enemies or heroes who heal a lot.

name: Transcendent Cooldown
text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

effects.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item that costs 6,400 souls and is built from Superior Cooldown. It reduces the cooldown of your abilities by 25% and of your items by 25%, and adds 4 extra regeneration out of combat.
beginner.whyItMatters: It speeds up item buttons as well as abilities.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it late for a hero with many abilities and active items.

name: Trophy Collector
text: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

effects.text: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 vitality item built from Sprint Boots. Each kill or assist adds a stack, up to 16, with extra sprint speed, ability range and 16 souls per minute that persist through death. It also adds 2 metres per second of sprint speed and 2 extra regeneration out of combat, but lowers your weapon damage to non-player units by 15%.
beginner.whyItMatters: It grows with your success and gives you extra income and range over time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when you expect to get kills and assists. It is a weak pick if you are not involved in fights.

name: Unstable Concoction
text: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

effects.text: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 5 spirit legendary with a button, offered only in the Street Brawl draft. Press it to become unstoppable for 4 seconds with 150% Weapon Damage, 150 Spirit Power, 3,000 health and 10 metres per second of move speed. Then you die in an explosion that stuns enemies within 22 metres for 3 seconds and deals 30% of your maximum health as damage. Your respawn is 50% shorter.
beginner.whyItMatters: It is a trade of your own life for a huge burst, and the shorter respawn softens the cost.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Only used in Street Brawl. Press it when you are about to die anyway, or in a large group of enemies.

name: Unstoppable
text: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

effects.text: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 vitality item that costs 6,400 souls and is built from Debuff Reducer. Press it to ignore stuns, silences, sleep, roots and disarms for 5.5 seconds. It also gives 25% Debuff Resist and 125 health.
beginner.whyItMatters: It lets you act through the effects that would normally stop you. You cannot press it while stunned or asleep, so you have to use it before you are caught.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it when enemies keep stopping you with stuns. Press it when a fight starts, before their control abilities land.

name: Vampiric Burst
text: Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

effects.text: Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 vitality item with a button, built from Bullet Lifesteal. Press it for 5 seconds of 70% bullet lifesteal, 34% fire rate and 75% extra ammo that can go over your magazine size. The cooldown is 30 seconds. It also adds 13% bullet lifesteal, 10% Bullet Resist, 100 health and 6% Weapon Damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: A short burst that makes your gun both much faster and a healer.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it at the start of a gunfight against a group, when you can keep firing for the full 5 seconds.

name: Veil Walker
text: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

effects.text: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 vitality item that costs 3,200 souls. Walking through a cosmic veil on the map makes you invisible for 8 seconds, heals you for 85 and gives you 3.5 metres per second of move speed while invisible. The cooldown is 15 seconds. It also adds 125 health and 6 Spirit Power.
beginner.whyItMatters: The map has special veils, and this item turns them into a way to sneak, heal and travel quickly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who roams and ambushes. It is of little use if you stay far from veils.

name: Vortex Web
text: Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex. Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

effects.text: Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex. Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 spirit item with a button, built from Slowing Hex. Throw a grenade that pulls all enemies within 12 metres into a small area and slows them by 28% for 4 seconds. You can also target an enemy directly. The cooldown is 42 seconds. It also adds 8% ability range and a little sprint speed.
beginner.whyItMatters: It gathers a team into one spot where your area abilities hit all of them.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it just before an area attack from you or your team.

name: Warp Stone
text: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

effects.text: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 vitality item with a button that costs 3,200 souls. Press it to teleport 11 metres straight ahead and gain 30% Bullet Resist for 6 seconds. The cooldown is 16 seconds.
beginner.whyItMatters: A fast way to escape, jump a wall or close a gap, and the resistance helps you survive after you arrive.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use it to get away when you are low or to reach a target. Since you teleport forward, aim before you press.

name: Weakening Headshot
text: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

effects.text: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 weapon item that costs 1,600 souls. Landing a headshot lowers the target's Bullet Resist by 12% for 12 seconds. It also adds 60 health. It builds into Crippling Headshot.
beginner.whyItMatters: One headshot makes the target easier for you and your allies to shoot.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Pick it if you aim well and your team relies on bullets. It is the first step toward Crippling Headshot.

name: Weapon Shielding
text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

effects.text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 2 vitality item built from Grit. If you take 250 weapon damage from enemy heroes within 4 seconds you gain a 300 point Barrier for 8 seconds. The cooldown is 35 seconds. It also adds 18% Bullet Resist and 2.5 extra regeneration out of combat.
beginner.whyItMatters: It soaks up a burst of gunfire automatically.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it against a team that deals damage with bullets.

name: Weighted Shots
text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

effects.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 3 weapon item that costs 3,200 souls and is built from Slowing Bullets. Your bullets build up a 24% movement slow for 3.5 seconds. It also adds 30% Weapon Damage and 22% Debuff Resist, but lowers your Stamina recovery by 14% and your move speed a little.
beginner.whyItMatters: Strong damage and resistance to debuffs, paid for with a slower you. It suits a fighter who stands their ground.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it for a hero who stays in place and trades bullets. A hero who relies on dashing should avoid it.

name: Witchmail
text: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

effects.text: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

beginner.whatItIs: A tier 4 vitality item that costs 6,400 souls. Each heavy spirit hit you take (over 75) from an enemy reduces the cooldown of one random ability by 4 seconds. The effect can happen once per second. It also adds 22% resistance to spirit damage and 14 Spirit Power.
beginner.whyItMatters: Being hit by abilities gets your own abilities back sooner, so you strike back faster.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Buy it against a team that casts a lot of spirit damage at you.
